author: reek
body: Lowers a system-neutral WorldModel Entity into a REAL CodexMagic CardTemplate (not the HTML mockup the slice draws). The same tagged abstraction the SD / D&D emitters read is mapped, field by field, into the actual card data model the CodexMagic engine plays with: a weapon becomes a Legendary Artifact Equipment, a character becomes a Legendary Creature. Power tier drives rarity and P/T; granted-effects map to real Keywords; vocation drives the mana cost and colours. Because it produces a genuine CardTemplate, the result can be priced (cmc), coloured (cost-colors), and formatted by Card's own helpers.
